thread:
sara-support: heads-up: AcmeCorp reporting intermittent 504s to /v1/generate since 2026-03-18T09:23Z. p95 ~18s, p99 >30s. example request-id=rid:acme:0a1b2c. they attached traces and a curl repro.

sara-support: curl -v 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' --data '{"input":"...longseq replay..."}' -> 504

miguel-sre: looking. any deploys around 09:20-09:24? also which region/tenant? could be queue saturation + slow dequeue.

deploy-bot: automated-deploy: rollout/hosted-api-v3 started 6578901000 by ryan-runtime. status: paused (error rate increased)

ryan-runtime: I'm seeing hosted-ingress queue depth spike for tenant acme-us-east: current_depth=915 max_configured=1000. continuous batch backlog increasing; average batch size jumped to 48 -> high KV miss ratio causing CPU kernel to slow.

anya-eng: can you paste the ingress metrics? especially `enqueue_rate`, `dequeue_rate`, `avg_batch_size`, and `kvcache_miss_rate` for 09:15-09:30

ryan-runtime: grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ingress?orgId=1&from=2026-03-18T09:10&to=2026-03-18T09:35

ryan-runtime: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-18T09:22:18Z WARN hosted-ingress queue_enqueue: tenant=acme depth=820 threshold=800
2026-03-18T09:23:07Z WARN batcher.dequeue slow_dequeue_ms=1450 batch_size=56 kvcache_miss=0.62
2026-03-18T09:23:20Z ERROR gateway timeout req=rid:acme:0a1b2c tenant=acme status=504 reason="batcher-tail-timeout"
```

miguel-sre: pattern looks like continuous-batcher backlog where some longseq heavy requests inflate batch sizes and stall dequeues. when batcher waits on large KV misses, tail latency for everyone suffers -> gateway 5xx. we've seen this before with thinpool starvation.

katie-cs: Acme says they queued a large historical replay at 09:21 (internal job). they've paused it for now.

miguel-sre: immediate mitigations we should try (short list):
- enable early_reject for tenant acme (drop requests once queue depth > 850)
- reduce max_batch_size from 64 -> 32 for ingress pool in us-east to limit stall amplification
- bump autoscale override +20% for hosted-ingress in us-east
- if necessary, enable tenant burst isolation (route acme to dedicated pool temporarily)

ryan-runtime: I can push a config patch for batcher: `max_batch_size=32, enqueue_timeout_ms=200, early_reject_threshold=850` and flip thinpool early_reject. snippet:
```
PATCH /config/ingress/us-east
{
  "batcher": {"max_batch_size":32, "enqueue_timeout_ms":200},
  "early_reject_threshold":850
}
```

anya-eng: do the small config change first (no deploy), then assess. if that stabilizes, we can revert the rollout and re-enable deploy-bot.

sara-support: implemented throttle on customer side and requested they keep their replay paused. ACME confirms paused at 09:27 UTC.

ryan-runtime: applied config override at 09:28:12Z to us-east ingress. immediate effect: avg_batch_size dropped to ~28, dequeue latency per batch dropped from 1450ms -> 420ms (prelim). queue depth trending down.

miguel-sre: also temporarily increased autoscale cap for us-east pool at 09:29 to add ~3 nodes (20% capacity). should watch eviction/kvspin.

katie-cs: Acme reports error rate falling to baseline; 504s reduced by ~90% per their telemetry.

oncall-amber: I'm creating incident ticket INC-2026-657890. severity: medium (customer-impacting, mitigated). adding action items for postmortem.

anya-eng: note: root cause hypothesis: tenant-initiated replay caused a longseq-heavy request mix that increased batch formation times; combined with kvcache miss storm -> continuous batch backlog -> thinpool starvation and tail-timeouts. instrumentation shows kvcache_miss_rate spiked to 0.63 at 09:23.

miguel-sre: follow-ups:
- add tenant-level replay detection / graceful-throttle (solutions: soft quota or background-job flagging)
- add metric alert for avg_batch_size > 40 with sustained 1m window
- rework early_reject logic to avoid wide tail amplification (we currently default to evict=false)
- investigate kernel change in last rollout that might have made heavy KV misses slower (rollback candidate)

ryan-runtime: I'll schedule a canary rollback of the kernel path that changed eviction at 09:50; anything else I should do now? I'll keep the config overrides until next deploy.

sara-support: customer happy for now; they want root-cause and action plan. giving them ETA for postmortem 48h.

anya-eng: adding a repro guide for eng: steps to recreate (in test env):
1) run a mixed load with 40% short requests + 5% longseq replays that block KV lookups
2) enable continuous-batcher with batch_size_goal high (simulate) and disabled early_reject
3) watch `batcher_dequeue_ms` and `avg_batch_size` cross thresholds

miguel-sre: short-term mitigations are in place. I'll leave autoscale override for another 30m then roll it down. keep this thread updated.

sara-support: closing on-customer communication: emailed Acme at 09:41 with mitigation summary. leaving incident open for postmortem work.

deploy-bot: rollout/hosted-api-v3 status: paused. queued rollback candidate prepared by ryan-runtime.

oncall-amber: assigning owners: ryan-runtime (runtime changes), anya-eng (postmortem + repro), miguel-sre (alerts + scaling rules), katie-cs (customer comms). expected follow-up meeting in 48h.

sara-support: thanks all. will update INC ticket with links and timeline.
